newsitem.title: FINLAND: ALCOM SAYS TO SELL HYTAR TO AVS OY.
newsitem.headline: ALCOM SAYS TO SELL HYTAR TO AVS OY.

text.p: Finnish data systems group Alcom Oy said on Friday it had signed a letter of intent to sell its Hytar Oy hydraulic components unit to Automatik Ventiler System Oy(AVS Oy) for a sum to be decided later.
"The sale price will be based on earnings expectations for future years," Alcom said in a statement.
The deal was subject to approval by Alcom's extraordinary shareholders' meeting and dependent on AVS Oy's financing arrangements, Alcom said.
"Hytar Oy is one of the country's leading companies in the hydraulic components business. The company's net sales last year were 67 million markka," Alcom said.
AVS Oy had 1996 net sales of 62 million markka, it said.
